scope: bounded reproducible SU(3) Wilson-action Markov-chain ensemble generation and diagnostics

literature_context.metropolis_reference: N. Metropolis et al., J. Chem. Phys. 21, 1087 (1953), DOI 10.1063/1.1699114
literature_context.su3_update_context: N. Cabibbo and E. Marinari, Phys. Lett. B 119, 387 (1982), DOI 10.1016/0370-2693(82)90696-7
literature_context.heatbath_context: A. D. Kennedy and B. J. Pendleton, Phys. Lett. B 156, 393 (1985), DOI 10.1016/0370-2693(85)91632-6
literature_context.implementation_claim: the reference independently specifies a symmetric single-generator Metropolis kernel; it does not claim to implement Cabibbo-Marinari quasi-heatbath or Kennedy-Pendleton heatbath

angle_grid.support: paired nonzero binary64 grid strictly inside (-proposal_angle,+proposal_angle)
angle_grid.exact_inverse_pairing: toggle bit 63 while preserving low 52 bits; resulting floating angle is exactly -theta

proposal.rotation: R=exp(i theta T^a) using frozen YM-SU3-ALGEBRA-V1 exponentiation
proposal.proposal_symmetry: the implemented finite floating proposal grid has exact equal-probability theta/-theta pairs
proposal.acceptance: min(1,exp(-DeltaS)) with DeltaS the frozen Wilson-action local difference
proposal.acceptance_draw_rule: consume one uniform acceptance draw for every proposal, including DeltaS<=0
proposal.beta_zero_rule: DeltaS=0 and every valid proposal is accepted

local_action.definition: for link U_mu(x), sum the forward and x-nu plaquettes for every nu!=mu using 1-(1/3)ReTr P
local_action.candidate_evaluation: allocation-free substitution of the candidate into the six affected plaquettes; no full-lattice clone
local_action.regression: local DeltaS must match the full Wilson-action difference on a deterministic one-link proposal

update_order.markov_sweep: one proposal for every generator at every link in the frozen nested order

schedule.thermalization: discard thermalization_sweeps complete Markov sweeps before measurements
schedule.measurement_cadence: perform sweeps_between_measurements complete Markov sweeps before each recorded measurement
schedule.total_sweep_count: thermalization_sweeps + measurements*sweeps_between_measurements, checked for overflow and bounded

diagnostics.definition_source: reuse the frozen Phase 2A arithmetic/autocorrelation/ESS definitions as numerical utilities, without inheriting the SU(2) sampler contract
